# r/EntrepreneurConnect

A subreddit: strict self-promotion rules, and moderators remove ad-like posts fast.

## Steps
1. Open https://www.reddit.com/r/EntrepreneurConnect/submit and read the rules (sidebar, wiki, FAQ or guidelines).
2. Write a post for this specific audience from `copy.reddit_post` / `copy.launch_post_story`, following skill/human-writing.
3. `launchkit draft r-entrepreneurconnect -` with title, body, flair and best posting time, then `launchkit mark r-entrepreneurconnect drafted`.
4. Only if `launch_settings.allow_social_posting` is true and the user approved this draft: post it, then mark `submitted --listing-url <post url>`.

## Make the listing perform
- Read the sidebar rules and any self-promo day. Write a story-first post tailored to this sub.
- Save with `launchkit draft <id> -` and mark `drafted`. Post only if the user approved this draft.
